¡Hola! Soy Muffy y hoy soy tu instructor: Hi! I'm Muffy and today I'm your instructor. The crews are cats and the tanks are real. First you choose a battalion: the British, who won't fight without tea; the Soviets, who attack all together; the Americans, who fix everything; or the Italians, who wait camouflaged and ambush. Battles are 3 against 3.
Cada gato tiene una manía. Earl Grey rec: Every cat has a quirk. Earl Grey regains morale if he stays put drinking tea; Boris has a huge gun but reloads slowly. Check each tank's card to learn its quirk. And every cat brings its own cards.
El campo de batalla es una mesa de carta: The battlefield is a table of cards. Open ground costs 1 movement. Forest and ruins cost 2, but they cover you: +1 and +2 armor. Face-down cards are rocks: you can't drive through them or see through them, so you can't shoot through them either (artillery can, because it falls from above). In the desert, dunes also block the view and mines (⚠) go off on a 1 or a 2 on the die; the river can't be crossed except by the bridge or the ford.
Haz clic en uno de tus tanques para eleg: Click one of your tanks to select it. The blue squares show how far it can go. Click one to move; you can split the movement into several steps.
¡Ojo con la flecha amarilla! Cada tanque: Watch the yellow arrow! Each tank faces where it took its last step. The front is the most armored; the flank and the rear, much less. Go around the enemies and hit them from the side.
Y ella es la teniente Michi, que explica: And this is Lieutenant Michi, who explains the cards. Sometimes she shows up in battle for a surprise inspection and gives orders: obey her. And a tip: don't try to pet her.
Escucha bien, recluta, que no lo voy a r: Listen up, recruit, I won't say it twice. Every cat has its own cards: pick a tank and you'll see them below, with its cat's face. Everyone shares 3 energy per turn; each card is used once per turn and some need to reload. Pick the target by clicking an enemy and hover over a card to see the damage. Understood? Good.
El enemigo avisa lo que va a hacer. No e: The enemy announces what it's going to do. That's not kindness, it's pure clumsiness. Select it and you'll see in red how far it can hit. And aim well: if you shoot one that isn't in front of you, you lose 2 damage. Use Face Target first, which also turns your armored front to it. And don't embarrass me.
La moral. Cada tanque tiene 5. Si te peg: Morale. Each tank has 5. If you get hit hard, the crew gets scared; at 0 it panics and won't shoot. Earl Grey's Tea Time raises it. I don't need tea: I was born with high morale.
Cuando no te quede nada por hacer, pulsa: When there's nothing left to do, press End turn. Defeat all the enemies to win! Every tank you knock out lets you pick one of its cards as loot, and whatever you don't use goes to your Arsenal. On Veteran and Ace you can call in a plane once per battle; on Ace the enemy can too: if you see a red crosshair, get out of that square! On turn 3 the Frontline Die is rolled: it might rain, get foggy or bring fish for everyone. And don't worry: if a tank falls, its cat always jumps out and escapes safely. Is the crew ready?

Los primeros Centurion llegaron a Bélgic: The first Centurions reached Belgium in May 1945, just as the war in Europe was ending: they never got to fight. Afterwards it served for more than 50 years in many countries.
Era un Sherman con el gran cañón británi: It was a Sherman with the big British 17-pounder gun. Since the Germans tried to destroy it first, crews sometimes painted half of the barrel so it looked shorter.
Lento pero increíble en terreno difícil:: Slow but amazing on rough ground: its gearbox let it turn on the spot, and in Tunisia (1943) it climbed hills the Germans thought were impossible for a tank.
Su cañón de 122 mm era enorme: el proyec: Its 122 mm gun was huge: the shell and the charge were loaded separately, so it fired only 2 or 3 times a minute. That's why Boris reloads slowly.
Uno de los tanques más fabricados de la: One of the most produced tanks in history. Its sloped plates deflected shells, an idea that many later tanks copied.
Se fabricaron cerca de 50.000. Tenía un: Nearly 50,000 were built. It had a gyroscopic stabilizer that kept the gun aimed even while the tank moved, and it was easy to repair at the front.
El vehículo de cadenas más rápido de la: The fastest tracked vehicle of the war. It was a tank destroyer: very thin armor and an open-top turret, all to be fast.
Llegó al final de la guerra. En marzo de: It arrived at the end of the war. In March 1945, in Cologne, a Pershing won a duel against a Panther in front of the cathedral, and an army cameraman filmed it.
Fue el tanque italiano más fabricado de: It was the most produced Italian tank of the war and fought mostly in North Africa. The British captured so many in 1941 that they equipped whole units with them.
Lo hicieron como cañón de apoyo para la: It was built as an artillery support gun, with no turret and very low. With shaped-charge ammunition (EP, “effetto pronto”) it ended up being one of the best Italian tank destroyers at El Alamein.
Era el tanque pesado italiano, pero lleg: It was the Italian heavy tank, but it came too late: about 100 were built, and almost all of them were used by the German army after the Italian armistice of September 1943.
En Normandía (1944) esperaban dando vuel: In Normandy (1944) they circled in the air, lined up like taxis (the “cab rank”), until the soldiers on the ground radioed them to attack a target.
una «bañera» blindada alrededor del moto: an armored “bathtub” around the engine and cockpit
Es el avión militar más fabricado de la: It's the most produced military aircraft in history: about 36,000. It was called the “flying tank”, and at Kursk (1943) it dropped hundreds of small PTAB anti-tank bombs in a single pass.
8 ametralladoras de 12,7 mm, bombas y co: 8 × 12.7 mm machine guns, bombs and rockets
Era tan grande y pesado que le decían «J: It was so big and heavy they called it the “Jug”. It was famous for being tough: many made it back to base with huge holes.
2 ametralladoras de 12,7 mm y bombas chi: 2 × 12.7 mm machine guns and small bombs
Fue uno de los últimos biplanos de caza: It was one of the last biplane fighters in the world. By 1940 it was already outdated, so in North Africa it was used a lot for ground attack.
